description: Source code for bcm4908img utility functions, including parsing, creating, extracting, and managing boot filesystem images for BCM4908 devices, with endianness handling, CRC32 checksum calculations, and command-line interface.

methods.name: bcm4908img_info
methods.description: Displays information about a BCM4908 image file, including offsets and checksum.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create
methods.description: Creates a new BCM4908 image file by appending files, padding zeros, and writing a tail with checksum.

methods.name: bcm4908img_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified data segments (cferom, bootfs, rootfs, firmware) from a BCM4908 image file.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs
methods.description: Manages boot filesystem commands such as listing and renaming files within the bootfs of a BCM4908 image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_parse
methods.description: Parses a BCM4908 image to identify offsets, verify CRC, and extract metadata.

methods.name: bcm4908img_open
methods.description: Opens a file or stdin for reading, with checks against TTY and FIFO.

methods.name: bcm4908img_close
methods.description: Closes a file if it is not stdin.

methods.name: bcm4908img_calc_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a segment of the image file.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_ls
methods.description: Lists files in the boot filesystem of the image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_mv
methods.description: Renames a file within the boot filesystem of the image.
